fact: On 28 November 2023 the Public Private Partnership Commission said it and the Department of E-Government are implementing, for ten years with World Bank funding under the Digital Malawi Project, a connectivity initiative to bring optic fibre internet to public institutions including District Commissioners' offices; Mwanza District Council's systems analyst urged that installation in the district be expedited before the project closed in June 2024, so the district was not yet connected.
title: PPPC, E-govt sensitize Mwanza MDAs on PPP Connectivity Initiative
